ei.title: Oral Health: Gateway to Overall Health
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Nearly everything has to go through your mouth to get to the rest of you, from food and air to bacteria and viruses. A healthy mouth can help your body get what it needs and prevent it from harm — with adequate space for air to travel to your lungs, and healthy teeth and gums that prevent harmful microorganisms from entering your bloodstream. From the moment you are created, oral health affects every aspect of your life. What happens in the mouth is usually just the tip of the iceberg and a reflection of what is happening in other parts of the body. Poor oral health can be a cause of a disease that affects the entire body. The microorganisms in an unhealthy mouth can enter the bloodstream and travel anywhere in the body, posing serious health risks.

det.analysis:

✅ ③ the tip of the iceberg(빙산의 일각): 입에서 일어나는 일은 빙산의 일각이고 실제로는 몸 전체에 영향 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 posing serious health risks(심각한 건강 위험을 초래하며)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① maintaining overall wellness(전반적 건강 유지): 건강하지 않은 입의 미생물이 혈류에 들어가는 부정적 맥락과 불일치

❌ ② promoting immune function(면역 기능 촉진): 부정적 결과여야 하므로 부적합

❌ ③ strengthening dental structure(치아 구조 강화): 문맥상 부정적 결과여야 함

✅ ④ posing serious health risks(심각한 건강 위험 초래): unhealthy mouth + 미생물이 혈류 침입 → 위험 초래 ←정답
det.tip: pose a risk = 위험을 초래하다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

❌ ④ 원문: can enter the bloodstream — 들어갈 수 있다고 명시
det.tip: prevent ~ from entering = ~가 들어가는 것을 막다

구강 건강은 신체 일부 측면에만 영향을 미친다.

입에서 일어나는 일은 항상 신체 전체 상태를 정확히 보여준다.

questions.passage: Nearly everything has to go through your mouth to get to the rest of you, from food and air to bacteria and viruses. A healthy mouth can help your body get what <u>it</u> needs and prevent it from harm — with adequate space for air to travel to your lungs, and healthy teeth and gums that prevent harmful microorganisms from entering your bloodstream. From the moment you are created, oral health affects every aspect of your life. What happens in the mouth is usually just the tip of the iceberg and a reflection of what is happening in other parts of the body. Poor oral health can be a cause of a disease that affects the entire body. The microorganisms in an unhealthy mouth can enter the bloodstream and travel anywhere in the body, posing serious health risks.
questions.stem:
밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

(A healthy mouth can help your body get what it needs and prevent it from harm)

det.korean: 당신의 신체(your body)를 가리킴
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 당신의 신체: A healthy mouth can help your body get what it needs — it은 앞의 your body를 대신하는 대명사 ←정답

❌ ① 건강한 입: 주어 A healthy mouth이므로 it이 가리키지 않음
❌ ② 충분한 공간: 이 문장의 주요 대상이 아님
❌ ③ 혈류: 뒤에서 언급되는 개념
det.tip: help A (to) V: A가 ~하도록 돕다. it = A(your body)
